actualPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: one independently painted animation frame, E cast frame 16 of 16 for the existing Cangzhanglin pet, no collage/spritesheet.
Input 1 is the strict E/front-three-quarter identity and camera reference; input 2 is the same identity from behind for anatomical consistency; input 3 is the primary approved painterly style/material reference only, never draw its UI or text.
Create the same round chibi wingless quadruped jade-armored qilin cub as reference 1, facing diagonally down-right. Preserve face and large blue-grey eyes, cream-white facial/chest fur, dark blue-grey cloud mane, exactly two naturally branching ivory antler groups with gold bases, two ears, exactly four natural short legs with cloven hooves, one single curled dark-and-ivory cloud tail, jade scale plates with warm gold trim, existing pendant and ivory ribbons. No new appendages, no wings, no weapon, no human anatomy.
Exact action moment: return near original neutral attentive stance for idle connection; head relaxed and aimed down-right, chest recovered, four hooves at the same original footprints. Only one or two extremely weak jade motes remain by antlers; mane and ribbons have nearly settled. This is one moment in a stationary neck-and-chest breathing cast. Do not step or translate. Anatomical LF/RF/LH/RH identities stay unchanged and naturally support the torso. Only the described pose and subtle cloth/mane follow-through change.
Camera/composition: fixed original E three-quarter front camera and angle throughout sequence. Full body, fixed size, 1024x1024 transparent RGBA canvas, ground anchor at top-left pixel [512,942], neutral body occupies approximately x80..945 and y85..942 with generous full antler/tail/ribbon margins. Maintain exact proportions and silhouette identity; avoid automatic zoom and centering changes. No floor, ground plane, drop shadow, labels, border, watermark, text, checkerboard, or background.
Style: match reference 1 detailed bright clean rounded Taoist chibi high-definition hand painting, jade translucent luster, warm fine gold, soft ivory fabric and delicately painted fur; primary style reference 3 informs finish. Requested creative target ChatGPT Images 2.5 highest available visual quality; this prompt is not a model or quality selector.
Return exactly one single frame.
Input 4 is the accepted native initial cast frame: use it strictly to lock canvas scale, identity details and the neutral hoof footprint throughout the sequence. Paint the new described pose independently; do not simply reproduce input 4.
